data.title: Kelmarsh wind farm data
data.modifications: Derived training-bin means, statistical coefficients and evaluation aggregates from original 2018 wind/power rows; source raw records are not redistributed here.

methods.basis: Static nonlinear and predefined piecewise-linear power-curve benchmark family. Primary HTML read via web, local retrieval failed SSL validation; different Vestas V80 data. Our 0.5m/s training-mean knots are our prespecified design, not exact paper replication or imported thresholds.
Kelmarsh source/SCADA/event context, primary HTML read via web. No paper neural method or outage-week filter reproduced. Local Crossref metadata only; local publisher HTML 403.
